status: implementation contract frozen before targeted tests
sourceOfPatterns: Root design decision supplied before tests. Literal independent expectations; tests must not import a product role-pattern table to obtain expected values.
precedence: An explicit local dashed true/false replaces the default role pattern; undefined retains role defaults. Local width/stroke follow the existing preset behavior. Monochrome keeps neutral output color without deleting stored source color overrides. Effective pattern is part of actual Scene/render/grouping/proof/router style identity, not a detached SVG decoration.

baselineProtection.cnn12: For original documents without overrides: complete nodes, canonical and projected ports, all edge canonical fields, hidden-edge partition, existing paths/label positions, source facts and document bytes remain exactly equal to corresponding frozen artifacts. Monochrome changes effective pattern and required truthful footer only. Paper same-mode Scene and SVG retain original bytes.
baselineProtection.transformerHistorical: Use the four raw historical documents as source/fact fixtures. Compare paper and monochrome current observations to their frozen canonical geometry with only known preset palette changes; new role patterns/footer may differ. Historical pixels are not current browser acceptance.
baselineProtection.overridesException: Explicit defaults versus solid/dashed overrides can now have different effective patterns despite previously equal dashed booleans. Correct split/merge changes are permitted only for these overridden fixture branches. Canonical coverage, targets, unrelated node geometry and source facts remain protected. New Scene path/bundle count is an observation, never an automatically updated expected gold.

legend: Represent each actually visible role/effective-style variant truthfully; samples use the same stroke/width/pattern as their member edges, with complete nonduplicated membership. Hidden-only roles cannot appear. Manual node legends retain IDs/text/order; generated line variants stay separate and avoid collisions. Geometry fits page bounds and avoids node/header/backplate/manual legend/annotation bodies. Detail rerenders its actual boundary edges and places citation below every footer item.
rendering: Compare actual Scene/public interactive SVG/actual export within their corresponding modes. Every rendered edge path must preserve role/tensor/canonical metadata and effective line pattern. Publication omits interaction controls; complete XML equality across modes is not required. Detail scope remains exhaustive and mutually exclusive.
history: A preset change and explicit edge override use typed visual operations. Undo/redo restores exact preset/override behavior with monotonic revision; JSON roundtrip preserves source/document data. Root native browser save/reload/export will independently establish actual persistence.
negativeControls: Canonical role or endpoint corruption with otherwise coherent metadata
Same-tensor role merge or lost duplicate branch
Explicit solid override silently replaced by role dashes
Legend with hidden role, incorrect pattern/style, incomplete/duplicated membership or collision
Hidden inspector fallback disagreeing with the effective pattern
Detail boundary style omission or citation/footer overlap
limits: Machine/AI verification remains separate from physical publication, real researchers, global optimality/beauty and presented performance. No model execution or dependency installation is authorized by this contract.
